clip_selection.decision_maker: semantic edit director constrained by the official transcript and license receipt
rules: Cut on complete speaking turns, never mid-sentence.
Match the clip to the narration claim and named speaker.
Keep the original voice audible; narration may bridge context but must not distort the quote.
Generate captions from the selected clip audio and verify them against the official minutes/transcript.
Reject clips with missing license evidence, unclear speaker identity, transcript mismatch, or third-party inserts.
Record start/end timestamps, speakers, transcript excerpt and editorial reason for owner review.
